knotly.aiHelp: Canned Sri Lanka prompts — not a live model. We route you to the right checklist, vendor, or WhatsApp note.
knotly.aiNekathAnswer: Confirm the poruwa minute with a pandith first. Photography, guest coaches, and the dresser trial all count backwards from that time — not a US 4pm cue.
knotly.aiVenueAnswer: 250–400 plates usually belong in a Negombo or Colombo garden hall. Galle and beach lawns need monsoon backup and extra coaches. Price transport before the deposit.
knotly.aiBudget: How do we split LKR pots?
knotly.aiBudgetAnswer: Keep bride-family, groom-family, and couple pots separate. Record paid vs spent so pending deposits stay visible. Jewellery hire often sits on the groom side.
knotly.aiWhatsapp: What do we send on WhatsApp?
knotly.aiWhatsappAnswer: Date, guest count with a 10–12% buffer, ceremony types (poruwa / nikah / church), and whether you are planning from overseas. Keep Amma on the thread.
